The '''angry machine''' was a device utilized by [[Wikyochee]], a ten-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old member of a [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Although generally agreeable, Wikyochee would occasionally slip into a more violent temper. The angry machine he possessed would calm his body down and allow him to return to a more affable state.<ref name="daa" />

==Behind the scenes==
The angry machine was created through the [[1996]] "[[Design An Alien]]" competition by a ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan named [[Aaron Reeder]], who was eleven years old at the time. In Reeder's entry for Wikyochee, which was published in the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 7|seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]'' as an "honorable mention," the machine was mentioned as a part of his blurb for the character.<ref name="daa" /> [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], later confirmed that published "Design an Alien" material was considered [[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="tt">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=Star Wars Galaxy Magazine #7 published the winners of the 'Design an Alien' contest, where fans were encouraged to submit artwork and backstories of new SW aliens. Are these aliens canon? [...] Yes, though any text discrepencies with other sources would likely to superceded by the other source.}}</ref>
